holder-quote: Then she gestured at Lady Zanthia and the specter.
effect-quote: Now Eliasor saw a face. Legs. Clothing appearing in details with each passing second.

holder-quote: Yet it was a he. A glowing figure, stepping out of forever. As Lady Zanthia danced, gracefully amid the moonlight, he appeared.
effect-quote: [The Eternal Partner]. He bowed and she nodded to him. Smoothly, the Stitch-man stepped into the shadows. And they parted at the touch of his sword.
